Too much screen time can silently strain your eyes and affect your vision over time. Prolonged use of mobiles, laptops, and digital screens often leads to eye fatigue, dryness, blurred vision, and headaches—commonly known as digital eye strain.

Make eye care a daily habit. Blink more often to keep your eyes moist and comfortable. Follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for at least 20 seconds. Adjust screen brightness, maintain proper posture, and ensure adequate lighting while working on screens.

Limiting screen time not only protects your eyes but also improves focus, productivity, and overall eye health. Regular eye check-ups help detect early signs of strain and prevent long-term damage. Take small steps today to protect your vision for the future.

Lifestyle factors such as long screen hours, stress, pollution, and aging can gradually impact eyesight. Common causes of itchy watery eyes are often linked to everyday eye health issues and environmental factors. Eye allergies are one of the most frequent reasons, caused by dust, pollen, pollution, or pet dander, leading to redness, irritation, and excessive tearing. I had my eye cataract checkup, through my son's office .Had an appointment with Dr at 6 o'clock.I had confirmed with Afrin the receptionists ,then left for Dr Mehta's clinic.
The ambience of the clinic is very good,the staff Afrin is very helpful & humble.
I was called at the cabin and spoke to Dr & inform him earlier also had consulted 2 Dr's .as they don't come in my son's office panel so came here it's Cashless for us company will directly pay the money to Dr. Dr clinic I found latest equipment.
He used an instrument in both  eye  & got report from that report he said left eye needs to be done first.

Dr did my routine check ✅ up & then instruct Afrin will put drops & then  after 30- 45 minutes .will check again & need to do eye Sonography which charges I had to pay .I agreed and did the check up and the doctor  found my left Cataract eye should be done first & right eye later  after a gap of few days I agreed,Dr explained the process very patiently & I also questioned what doubts I had in my mind .The doctor said what precautions I have to take post & later after surgery also .I said I wanted to do a survey from here .So Dr gave a prescription of Medicine drops to put 2 days before & do blood test,ECG,Check & check BP  send reports to Dr if all reports are normal Dr will give appointment for surgery.
I was happy with the consultation.Did payment for my sonography check ✅ up.
Afrin explained to me about drops as mentioned in my file all instructions are mentioned clearly & then left.Dr said he will send my report to the company with all details which lenses are good for my eyes.

The doctor said they have different lenses from 30 thousand- to higher range the patient decides which lenses they need according to their budget patient decides.
Was happy with their services given so 5 ⭐ Star  for Doctor.
The clinic building is easily seen from road 🛣️.
The entrance of the building is not accessible ♿.
They have lift 🛗 in the building.
I saw a parking space also .

featured_reviews.review_text:
My father has been under this doctor’s care for glaucoma for more than 12 years, and we are extremely grateful for the treatment and guidance provided over the years.

What stands out most is how well the condition has been managed with minimal medication, without unnecessary changes or panic. The doctor explains things with great clarity, patiently answers questions, and always ensures we understand the situation clearly—this brings a lot of peace of mind to the patient as well as the family.

Beyond medicines, the doctor also gives practical advice on lifestyle, eye care habits, and stress management, which has really helped in long-term stability and confidence. The approach is calm, balanced, and focused on sustainable health rather than over-treatment.

We truly appreciate the consistency, transparency, and reassurance provided over the years. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable and experienced glaucoma specialist.

featured_reviews.name: Jayendra Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a patient of Dr.(Mr.)Rajul Parikh since January 2014. Since then with regular periodic follow-up check up he is treating my left eye to see that the glucoma is kept under control. Unfortunately, in June 2022 the glucoma in the right eye shot up affecting my vision. I was fortunate to have glucoma expert Doctor(Mr.)Rajul Parikh to attend to the problem with required glucoma surgery immediately. For two years post that surgery, some unforseen complications had cropped up but again I am grateful to Almighty - in the guise of Dr.(Mr.) Rajul Parikh that those complications had been sorted out. With regular check- ups by him. The glucoma is under control with rescued vision. At the end, I may conclude that it is difficult for me to think of or visualise my LIFE without the expertise of Dr.(Mr.) Rajul Parikh. My words " THANK YOU " to him would fall far short of my immense  " GRATITUDES "to him.
